name: mcp-libraryofcongress
description: MCP server for the Library of Congress. Search inside digitised newspaper pages, browse the catalogue by format, and read records and collections. No API key required.
long_description:
Search the text scanned off digitised American newspaper pages, search the Library of Congress catalogue by kind of thing, read one record section by section, and list the collections a curator built. No API key, no account.

The newspaper search is what this server exists for: it reads what optical recognition took off millions of scanned pages, so it finds a phrase that appears in no title and no catalogue record, and returns the paper, the date, the leaf and a link that opens it with the query applied.

tools.name: search_newspapers
tools.description: Find a phrase in the text of scanned newspaper pages.

query.description: Words or a quoted phrase, such as '"cure for influenza"'. The index reads the text off the pages themselves and holds single characters, so a query of one character is a query it answers.

location.description: The state a paper was published in, written as the Library writes it: 'new york', 'district of columbia'. It is the value 'state' carries on the matches this tool returns.

publication.description: One newspaper, named with its town and the years it ran: 'new-york tribune (new york [n.y.]) 1866-1924'. Take the wording from 'publication' on a match here, or from a title in search_items with media_type 'newspapers'.

max_excerpt_chars.description: Budget for one passage. Read it together with 'max_excerpts_per_match': the size of the answer is the product of the two and the number of matches.

max_excerpts_per_match.description: Passages to keep per match. A page holding the words several times yields several, and the later ones rarely say anything the first did not.

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Search one catalogue by title, creator or subject.

query.description: Words to look for in titles, creators and catalogue descriptions. The catalogue index holds no word of a single letter, so at least one word has to run to two letters or more, unless it is written in a script where one character is a word.

media_type.description: Which catalogue to search: books, photos, maps, audio, film-and-videos, manuscripts, notated-music or newspapers. 'newspapers' holds the papers themselves; a phrase printed on a page belongs in search_newspapers.

collection.description: A collection, named exactly as list_collections reports it under 'collection_filter'.

online_only.description: Keep to material with a digitised copy. Set false to include shelf-only records.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Read one record, section by section.

sections.description: Which parts to return. Each one beyond 'basic' adds to the size of the answer.

max_description_chars.description: Characters of the description to return in one call.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: The digital collections, with the filter each one takes.

searchable_only.description: Keep only the collections whose formats name a media_type, which are the ones search_items can be asked for.
